correctness.rationale: For every integer cover length, the minimal forbidden return words give the exact cofinite distance set, to which the classical renewal entropy equation applies. At the limiting root the exact renewal difference is \(q^N\) times a bounded Thue–Morse complement tail; uniform first and second derivative bounds give an \(O(Nq^{2N})\) error in entropy. Minimality of the Thue–Morse orbit closure identifies the exact phase cluster. Uniqueness of the binary expansion of 1 at the Komornik–Loreti base prohibits equal values for distinct orbit tails; uniform recurrence then prohibits isolated phase values. At most \(8r\) substitution factors of length \(r\) give exponential metric covers with zero Hausdorff dimension. The strict cover-drop witness is the period-N return word when the Nth digit is zero. The packaged checker passed 81,900 exhaustive finite word-membership comparisons and all 22 numerical-root diagnostics. Computations corroborate rather than prove infinite claims.
